sumi: Kicking off migration `mig_2026_08_userflags_adaptive` in the 03:00-04:30 PST window. Adds nullable `user_flags` jsonb. New here: adaptive-surge detector that auto-shrinks batch_size when DB metrics spike. Canary hold at 03:20.

deploybot: queued migration mig_202608 (id: mig-202608). Canary holdpoint set at 03:20. Controls: `/deploy abort 1745551234` `/deploy continue 1745551234` `/deploy update 1745551234 --param=value`.

eva: Idea: auto-shrink uses DB CPU% and lock-wait seconds. If cpu>70% or lock_wait>200ms => reduce batch by 50% and add 200ms sleep. If still degrading, fall back to read-only COPY for offending tenant.

darren: Agree. Exposing `POST /ops/backfill/auto_tune` to enable/disable per-tenant. Oncall token will have enable/disable perms. I'll wire endpoint and short-lived tokens.

sumi: Runbook SQL + adaptive backfill loop for ops bundle:

```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN user_flags jsonb NULL;

-- adaptive backfill loop (psql-style pseudocode)
DO $$
DECLARE bsize int := 5000;
BEGIN
  LOOP
    WITH batch AS (
      SELECT id FROM users WHERE user_flags IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT bsize
    )
    UPDATE users u SET user_flags = '{"flags":[]}' FROM batch b WHERE u.id = b.id;
    PERFORM pg_sleep(0.1 + random() * 0.2);
    -- metrics probe: if cpu>70 or lock_wait > 0.2 => bsize := GREATEST(500, bsize/2);
    -- persist checkpoint to backfill_progress table
  END LOOP;
END$$;
```

eva: We'll also add a quick canary validation: `./tools/check_sample --n=1200 --shard=0` and a small read-probe that exercises a few sensitive read paths that broke last time.

deploybot: config applied for 1745551234: batch_size=5000, min_batch=500, jitter_pct=12, concurrency=4, adaptive_tune=enabled. Start 03:00, canary 03:20.

oncall: Tokens for `/ops/backfill/auto_tune` posted to vault. Canary holdpoint reached 03:20; awaiting sample verification.

eva: Soft-verify ran at 03:22: 1200 samples, 0 mismatches. No p95 regression in 6m. `/deploy continue 1745551234`.

sumi: Ramp plan: initial batch_size=5000, cap at 7000, concurrency 4 -> 10 over 15m. Adaptive will reduce if needed.

darren: 03:33 adaptive detector triggered: CPU 78% and avg lock_wait 310ms -> auto-shrink to 2500 and add sleep +200ms. Event logged to /var/backfill/mig_202608/events.log.

eva: After shrink p95 returned to baseline within 2m. Left adaptive_tune enabled and continued. Not aborting.

~03:45 darren: Tenant 9923 reported repeated COPY IO failures. Adaptive switched that tenant to read-only COPY pipeline and flagged a ticket: #ops-9923. Ops will retry COPY with different IO parameters.

oncall: Used `POST /ops/backfill/auto_tune` to temporarily disable adaptive for tenant 9923 while engineers investigate. Action recorded.

sumi: Rollback criteria (agreed):
- p95 +12% for 10m
- error rate +3% absolute for 5m
- replication lag > 50s for 5m
- deadlocks >= 5 in 10m
If any trigger => `/deploy abort 1745551234` then snapshot progress, set migration_state='paused' and coordinate revert plan with product. Owner: sumi.

eva: Also adding a fast-fallback step: if adaptive_tune cannot stabilize within 8 minutes, pause new batches and run partial abort for big tenants only (avoid full window abort).

darren: All adaptive events and operator actions are being recorded in the events log and to the alert timeline.

~04:10 darren: Final status: small/medium tenants complete; big-tenant read-only COPYs retried and finished by 04:28. No full abort. Progress snapshot at /var/backfill/mig_202608/progress.json.

sumi: Post-run: uploaded events.log and progress.json, opened retro ticket to tune thresholds and build an automated adaptive dashboard. Will publish a short release-note blurb.

eva: Release note snippet: "Added `user_flags` column. Backfill completed in the maintenance window. Feature flag remains off until smoke testing. Rollback steps and revert playbook: /ops/runbooks/mig_202608_revert.md.""
